qualification.details: post: Educational Qualification | para pump operator: Matriculation (10th) with certificate in trade of electrician/wireman/diesel mechanic/pump mechanic/motor mechanic/pump operator cum mechanic from a recognized ITI, OR Matriculation (10th) with certificate in the above trades under the Skill Development Scheme of the Government | para fitter: Matriculation (10th) with ITI certificate in trade of Fitter/Plumber from a recognized ITI/Institute, OR Matriculation (10th) with certificate in the above trade under the Skill Development Scheme of the Government | multipurpose worker: Middle pass and its equivalent from a school duly recognized by the State Government. Candidates must compulsorily attach a detailed marks sheet of Middle Standard (or a marks certificate from the school Principal if the board did not issue one); shortlisting is based only on Middle Standard marks.

selection_process: Percentage of marks in Matriculation (calculated out of 5) 5
BPL family (as per prescribed annual income) 1
Relevant experience with JSV/HPPWD/CPPWD/PSUs or an outsourcing agency serving HP Jal Shakti Vibhag (0.5 marks per completed 6 months) 2
Percentage of marks in Middle Standard (calculated out of 6) 6
Minimum 6 months' experience in HP Govt./Semi-Govt. organization or an outsourcing agency serving HP Jal Shakti Vibhag (0.5 marks per completed 6 months) 2
Experience certificates will be verified from the issuing authority; false or non-satisfactory certificates will not be entertained. No TA/DA is payable for the skill or physical test.
how_to_apply: Obtain/fill the prescribed application proforma for the post you wish to apply for.
Attach all required attested/self-attested documents listed above.
Mention your mobile number (if any) in the application.
Clearly write the post applied for on the envelope.
Submit the application to the Office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Katrain, on or before 14.10.2026, 5:00 PM.
This recruitment does not have an online application process based on the notice provided; applications must be submitted physically.

content_sections.heading: HP JSV Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag (JSV), Division Katrain has released the JSV Katrain Recruitment 2026 notification for the recruitment of Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter and Multipurpose Worker posts. A total of 30 vacancies have been announced on a part-time basis, with applications invited through offline mode up to 14 October 2026, 5:00 PM. Download HP JSV Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

rows.educational_qualification: Matriculation (10th) with certificate in trade of electrician/wireman/diesel mechanic/pump mechanic/motor mechanic/pump operator cum mechanic from a recognized ITI, OR Matriculation (10th) with certificate in the above trades under the Skill Development Scheme of the Government

Matriculation (10th) with ITI certificate in trade of Fitter/Plumber from a recognized ITI/Institute, OR Matriculation (10th) with certificate in the above trade under the Skill Development Scheme of the Government

Middle pass and its equivalent from a school duly recognized by the State Government. Candidates must compulsorily attach a detailed marks sheet of Middle Standard (or a marks certificate from the school Principal if the board did not issue one); shortlisting is based only on Middle Standard marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HP JSV Recruitment 2026 (Offline Mode)
content_sections.text: Obtain/fill the prescribed application proforma for the post you wish to apply for. Attach all required attested/self-attested documents listed above. Mention your mobile number (if any) in the application. Clearly write the post applied for on the envelope. Submit the application to the Office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Katrain, on or before 14.10.2026, 5:00 PM. This recruitment does not have an online application process based on the notice provided; applications must be submitted physically.

faq.question: Q1. What is JSV Katrain Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by HP Jal Shakti Vibhag, Division Katrain, for 30 part-time posts of Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter, and Multipurpose Worker.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 30 posts in total – 8 Para Pump Operator, 3 Para Fitter, and 19 Multipurpose Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Matriculation with a relevant ITI/trade certificate for Para Pump Operator and Para Fitter; Middle pass for Multipurpose Worker.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Offline, by submitting the prescribed application form with required documents to the Executive Engineer, JSV Division Katrain.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Marks-based evaluation (academic percentage, BPL status/experience) plus a skill and/or physical test, as detailed in the selection criteria tables above.
